channel.title: The Apprentice
channel.desc: It's week 7, and the candidates take on a classic task - TV selling. The teams select products which they hope will win over the nation. They then take to the airwaves, hoping to sell their socks off on a TV shopping channel - all while Lord Sugar watches on. There's a dramatic boardroom showdown, and one candidate risks it all to keep their place in the process.
